protocol.hypothesis: z_next = a(k)*diag(lambda)*z + b*c(k), arbitrary complex scalars a(k),c(k), fixed complex lambda,b within each cell/time window
protocol.rationale: A common-activity damped Fourier bank under arbitrary common time-dependent amplitude and phase gauges has this form. Unit address normalization is included.
protocol.necessary_condition: For any three channels, the six time series Y_i*X_j (i!=j) have a constant linear dependence. Their temporal differences must therefore have rank <=5.
protocol.cell_selection: Each late target plus fixed cells 0,8,40,72,80; same as the four-column test
protocol.criterion: Active product differences exceed 1e-4 of level RMS; reject if sigma6/sigma1 > max(1e-3,10*conservative FP32 noise scale)
protocol.normalization: Normalize each product-difference column to unit L2; no fitting to choose a favorable triple
protocol.scope: No assumed frequency, input activity, gauge scale, or decay. Tests the native frequency coordinates; independent unconstrained inputs for every frequency are a different, unidentifiable model.
